none: PAS WMID-FF6346: Roman coin, a copper-alloy radiate of Allectus
contea di ritrovamento: Staffordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ , IMP C ALLECTVS P AVG

A worn copper-alloy Roman radiate, probably of Allectus (293-296). The coin is illegible on the reverse. The probably obverse legend, IMP C ALLECTVS P AVG, suggests the coin is from C Mint. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
